verdict.rationale: Vue's own docs describe an incrementally adoptable framework that scales down to a library ([vue-docs-2]). Community users note it can be added minimally to existing pages ([vue-comm-4]) and call it light-weight ([vue-comm-8]). This only glancingly implies a small, low-dependency client footprint; 'performant' and 'compiler-optimized rendering' describe runtime speed, not bundle size. Missing for 10: documented bundle size figures, tree-shaking or dead-code elimination details, dependency count or supply-chain posture, and independent bundle-size measurements.
